in_marathi.name: Ek
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The Number One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ek हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ek is a Sanskrit name derived from the number 'one'. It is a unisex name that holds spiritual significance in Hinduism. In Hindu mythology, Ek is symbolic of unity, oneness, and the beginning of creation.
